policy.host_dep_note: host_deps are NOT Go modules and never enter go.mod. They are software the OPERATOR installs on the host to upgrade a capability. Every one of them is optional by ADR-0016's stdlib-floor rule: without it the connector runs degraded, never broken. tools/check-deps.sh does not gate them — it matches on "module", which host entries deliberately do not carry.

deps.name: Coder WebSocket
deps.reason: no stdlib WebSocket; ws+wss native via stdlib TLS

deps.name: godbus DBus protocol talker
deps.reason: Linux Avahi via DBus; no stdlib DBus

deps.name: HashiCorp Vault Go client
deps.reason: secrets manager client SDK; signs licenses via Transit engine (ADR-0003), reads runtime secrets via KV

deps.name: golang-jwt v5 (JWT with EdDSA support)
deps.reason: license format JWT-EdDSA (ADR-0003); native Ed25519 support per RFC 8037

host_deps.name: Avahi mDNS/DNS-SD daemon
host_deps.redistribution_note: System package. Installed by the operator's package manager; dhs never ships it.
host_deps.capability: DNS-SD browse + advertise delegated to the system daemon
host_deps.talks_via: github.com/godbus/dbus/v5 on the system bus (pure Go, no CGo)
host_deps.without_it: Works, degraded: 500ms read-deadline jitter makes AMWA cascade-timing tests (test_05/15/16) unreliable.

host_deps.name: Bonjour Service for Windows (dnssd.dll)

license.note: mDNSResponder SOURCE is Apache-2.0. Apple's Windows SDK/installer is a separate distribution; bundling it in a product needs an agreement with Apple. Operator-installed here, so we redistribute nothing.

host_deps.redistribution_note: Operator downloads from Apple (registration required). Matches how Cerebrum and nmos-cpp behave on Windows.
host_deps.capability: DNS-SD browse + advertise delegated to the Bonjour service
host_deps.without_it: Works, degraded: same cascade-timing jitter as a Linux host with no Avahi.

install.windows: Install "Bonjour Print Services for Windows" or the Bonjour SDK for Windows from Apple (manual download).

host_deps.blocked_on: ADR-0016 CGo wrapper conflict (Path A vs Path B) is unresolved; CGo also breaks CGO_ENABLED=0 cross-compile.

host_deps.name: Bonjour (built into macOS)

license.note: Part of the OS. Nothing to install, nothing to redistribute.

host_deps.redistribution_note: Present on every macOS host; no install step.
host_deps.capability: DNS-SD browse + advertise delegated to the system daemon
host_deps.without_it: N/A — the daemon is always present; only our CGo binding is unwritten.
host_deps.blocked_on: Same CGo wrapper conflict as bonjour-windows.

host_deps.name: Npcap packet capture driver

license.note: NOT open source and NOT unrestricted. Free edition: use on at most 5 systems and NO external redistribution. Unlimited only when deployed exclusively alongside Wireshark, Nmap or Microsoft Defender for Identity. Any other fleet-wide or bundled use needs a paid OEM licence from Nmap Software LLC.

host_deps.redistribution_note: Hard blocker for bundling. We never ship it; the operator installs it, and on any host that already has Wireshark it is present under the unlimited exception.
host_deps.capability: Capture raw LLDP frames (Ethertype 0x88CC) on a local interface
host_deps.fallback: Device-reported LLDP over the device's own API; no local capture.
host_deps.without_it: Windows cannot capture LLDP locally at all: Windows raw sockets are IP-level and cannot see non-IP Ethertypes. IS-04 attached_network_device stays unset unless another source supplies it.

install.windows: Install Npcap from https://npcap.com/ (manual), or note that Wireshark already bundles it.

host_deps.decision_pending: Licence terms conflict with fleet-wide deployment. Preferred answer is to avoid it entirely: take LLDP from the device's own API rather than capturing on the host.

host_deps.name: Raw-capture privilege (no package)

license.note: Kernel interface, not a library. Nothing to install or licence.

host_deps.capability: Capture raw LLDP frames (Ethertype 0x88CC) via AF_PACKET (Linux) or BPF (macOS)
host_deps.talks_via: syscall (stdlib) — AF_PACKET socket on Linux, /dev/bpf* on macOS
host_deps.without_it: Capture returns a typed permission error; everything else runs.

install.darwin: run as root, or grant access to /dev/bpf*
